name: gamenet_player_row_list_reset
description: GameNetPlayerRowList::Reset clears the player-row list globals.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431c20 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x431c20 validates a leaf zeroing of g_GameNetPlayerRowList, g_GameNetPlayerRowTail, g_GameNetPlayerRowHead, and g_GameNetPlayerRowCount; the HLIL memset rendering is a decompiler artifact with no real call in assembly.
The registered native launch smoke seeds all four player-row globals with nonzero values, calls GameNetPlayerRowList::Reset directly, verifies they are cleared, and restores the prior globals.
